title: 'Hypnotised' Mumbai airhostess handed Rs 200 'dakshina' after rape by 'transgender'
content: Powai police arrested Anil Shinde within four hours of an FIR. He posed as a transgender person to gain entry into a building. Shinde allegedly sexually assaulted an airhostess after offering to cure her husband. He collected money from residents before fleeing the scene. Police traced the accused through autorickshaw driver and CCTV footage.

title: 'Definitely in scheme of things': India refuse to panic over Kuldeep after poor Galle Test
content: Kuldeep picked up just one wicket in 25 overs across both innings in Galle, while Ravindra Jadeja and Manav Suthar shared 14 wickets between them.

title: 'What's going on in the country?' Kejriwal slams BJP over attack on CJP volunteers
content: Arvind Kejriwal has accused BJP supporters of assaulting volunteers from the Cockroach Janata Party during their inspection of a local school. Reports indicate that the volunteers faced violence and had their vehicles damaged by villagers. They expressed frustration over police inaction, demanding that those responsible be arrested within 48 hours.

title: Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn
content: Meta CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, have acquired the historic Strancally Castle, a stunning Gothic mansion set on an expansive estate in Ireland. This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history.

title: ‘He killed his own mother’: YouTuber's startling claim in Lucknow double-murder suicide
content: A journalist alleged her sister's husband brutally beat their ailing mother to death.  The husband then allegedly shot his estranged wife dead outside her workplace.  He subsequently returned home and killed his own sister before taking his life.  The journalist detailed years of alleged abuse her sister endured before the shooting.  Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the tragic events and the firearms used.

title: ‘Live-in relationship akin to marriage, parents can’t interfere’: Delhi HC
content: The Delhi High Court has affirmed the status of live-in relationships, treating them similarly to marriage. It emphasized that consenting adults have the freedom to choose their partners free from external influence. The court also ensured police protection for a couple threatened by family members, affirming that societal biases cannot infringe upon the fundamental constitutional rights of individuals. This decision bolsters the legal legitimacy of such unions.

title: India’s office market set for sustained growth as 77% of firms plan to expand: Report
content: India's office market is set for expansion over the next two years.  Companies anticipate growth and seek high-quality, well-connected workplaces.  Global Capability Centres and business expansion will support this office demand.  Artificial intelligence is increasingly influencing future leasing decisions and strategies.  Flexible workspaces and commute connectivity will shape office location choices.

title: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal gives an update on Temple device
content: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal revealed the Temple wearable device is now smaller and more powerful.  Pre-orders for the limited launch edition will begin very soon.  The device is expected to ship before the end of 2026.  PV Sindhu was recently seen wearing the Temple device at a championship.  This device tracks blood flow and oxygenation inside the brain.

title: UAE turns desert sand into eco-friendly bricks using nearly half the cement
content: In a groundbreaking study, researchers have engineered eco-friendly bricks using desert sand and various industrial by-products. These bricks boast enhanced sulfate resistance when compared to traditional cement options. An innovative curing process at room temperature minimizes energy use, offering a sustainable alternative to Portland cement. However, further industrial evaluations are essential for these bricks to gain traction in the market.

title: In 2016, Burt's Bees co-founder gave US 87,500 acres; now it's a monument
content: Roxanne Quimby, the visionary behind Burt's Bees, initially embraced a life of artistic expression and sustainability before venturing into the business world. After partnering with Burt Shavitz, they created a beloved range of beeswax products. Motivated by her love for nature, Quimby invested her earnings into the conservation of Maine's forests, acquiring extensive land despite pushback from logging interests.

title: Elon Musk’s Starlink seeks India approval, says it will help ‘least served’
content: Starlink, founded by Elon Musk, is aiming to gain approval for its Generation 2 satellite constellation in India. This innovative system is designed to provide direct-to-device connectivity, particularly benefiting underserved communities. After facing rejection due to compliance issues in its earlier application, Starlink is hopeful as India considers expanding its spectrum bands for satellite communications. Regulatory clearances for non-geostationary satellite providers are still under review.

title: Harry and Meghan's California mansion may be sold as couple weighs return to Britain
content: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are contemplating selling their lavish Montecito mansion as the financial burden of over $600,000 annually in mortgage and property taxes weighs heavily. Initially purchased for $14.65 million, the estate is generating buzz among brokers, with potential sale prices estimated between $55 million and $65 million. A final decision may follow their relocation to the UK.

title: ‘Politics of anarchy’: BJP attacks Rahul Gandhi over police station protest
content: The BJP criticized Rahul Gandhi for protesting outside a police station.  He sought an FIR regarding alleged pellet gun injuries suffered by a student.  The BJP stated an FIR was already registered and a committee was investigating.  Rahul Gandhi accused the Home Minister of being scared of justice.  The Congress leader continued his protest until an FIR was filed.

title: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry reveal the secret behind their charity work
content: Stephen Curry and his wife, Ayesha Curry, have worked towards their charity together and now the two have opened up about dividing their work.

title: Brittany Mahomes' $15 million business empire beyond Patrick Mahomes
content: Brittany Mahomes has built a career that extends well beyond her connection to Patrick Mahomes. After retiring from professional soccer in 2017, she became a certified fitness trainer and launched Brittany Lynne Fitness. She later joined the ownership group of the Kansas City Current, while expanding her profile through social media and brand partnerships. Her journey reflects how she turned athletic experience into opportunities across fitness, entrepreneurship and women's sports.

title: 'Everyone has diabetes': Bihar minister says sugar price rise won’t matter much
content: Bihar minister Shrawan Kumar stated rising sugar prices will have little impact on consumers. He cited increasing diabetes cases as a reason for reduced sugar consumption. Opposition party RJD criticized the minister's insensitive remarks about common people. They also blamed central government policies for the sugar price increase. Meanwhile, retail sugar and onion prices are also seeing significant rises.

title: Treesa-Gayatri end India’s 15-year wait, assure Badminton World Championships medal
content: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a World Championships medal.  They achieved this after a comeback victory in the women's doubles quarterfinals.  This guarantees the unseeded Indian pair at least a bronze medal.  Their achievement marks the country's first medal in this event since 2011.  The pair has shown strong progress and resilience throughout their career.

title: 2 gangsters, 1 woman: Love triangle ends with blood on Nagpur street
content: A gangster died from stab wounds after a violent street fight.  He had gatecrashed a party where his rival was with his girlfriend.  The two men argued and fought for nearly thirty minutes.  The rival then snatched a knife and fatally stabbed the victim.  Police apprehended the accused at the scene with the murder weapon.

title: Prajwal Revanna rape case: Key witness reports threat calls after testimony
content: A key witness in the Prajwal Revanna rape trial reported receiving threatening phone calls. She expressed fear for her safety and her son's well-being to the court. The special court has ordered an inquiry into the alleged threats and directed police protection. Officials recently recovered electronic devices from Prajwal Revanna's prison cell. A separate investigation is underway regarding these recovered items.

title: ‘Smart’ gel turns solid to liquid with UV light: How does it work?
content: Scientists at the University of Birmingham have developed a multi-responsive smart gel that can switch between solid-like and liquid-like states when exposed to ultraviolet light, heat or acid. Built using foldamer molecules and palladium ions, the material could eventually support advances in drug delivery, smart sensors and catalysis. Advanced NMR techniques also enabled detailed atomic-level analysis of its structure.

title: 'Awarapan 2' Day 8: Emraan's film eyes Rs 110cr India net, crosses Rs 150cr worldwide
content: 'Awarapan 2' has stepped into its second week of release with a fair bit of swagger, having already cleared the Rs. 100 crore mark in domestic net earnings and shown no real signs of stumbling despite the usual weekday cooldown. The Emraan Hashmi-fronted sequel is now looking to build a fresh head of steam as it enters into its second-week run. The action thriller has crossed Rs 113 crore India net in Week 1 and Rs. 160 crore worldwide. Here's the latest Day 8 update and the milestones the sequel could target.

title: Why India may need a third aircraft carrier as China expands its fleet
content: Navies worldwide face challenges with aircraft carrier availability due to maintenance schedules. The US Navy currently has four carriers deployed and others undergoing essential upkeep. India operates two carriers and seeks a third to maintain optimal operational readiness. China is expanding its carrier fleet, posing a growing strategic challenge. Maintaining sufficient carrier numbers is crucial for projecting power in contested regions.

title: Dowry case against 11 after woman, son killed in Haryana
content: In a heartbreaking turn of events, a young woman and her infant were allegedly killed by her in-laws after they demanded a luxury SUV as dowry, subjecting her to escalating violence. Following a fierce disagreement, she returned to her marital home bearing gifts, only to suffer further abuse. The authorities are actively investigating the tragic deaths, with her husband in custody for further inquiries.

title: Watch: CJP volunteers attempting to inspect Rajasthan govt school attacked

Villagers prevented the CJP team from visiting the school, citing local capabilities. They also opposed the CJP's views and campaign for school improvements. The incident occurred as the CJP continues its 'School Thik Karo' campaign.

title: Why India is betting $1.2 billion on homegrown construction equipment
content: India plans a $1.2 billion incentive scheme for advanced equipment manufacturing. This initiative aims to reduce reliance on China for critical machinery. The government expects fresh investment and domestic production growth over seven years. The scheme will cover tunnel boring machines and fire-fighting equipment. This move supports India's growing infrastructure development needs.

title: Violence & vandalism rock JU: Part of Nandalal Bose-designed emblem broken
content: Clashes erupted on the Jadavpur University campus involving political groups and university symbols. Supporters of ABVP damaged the university's emblem, which was designed by Nandalal Bose. Alleged outsiders later entered the campus, tearing flags and posters of Left organizations. They also attempted to erase graffiti related to social justice issues. The incidents highlight tensions and differing ideologies on the academic grounds.

title: Watch: Bathinda villagers peel off newly laid road with bare hands
content: Residents of Kotbhara and Ramgarh Bhundar villages allege poor road construction quality. Portions of the newly laid road are reportedly peeling off and breaking apart. Villagers demonstrated the poor quality by peeling off sections with their hands. They have informed authorities and demanded an investigation into the roadwork. Officials stated they will investigate the allegations and take appropriate action.

title: World’s most powerful: Railways eyes 35 hydrogen trains; looks at cheaper green fuel
content: India currently has the world's most powerful hydrogen train in operation and has also established a dedicated facility for manufacturing and supplying hydrogen for the train. The initial target is to deploy 35 hydrogen-powered trains on heritage routes.

title: Inside India nets: Intent, big sixes and footwork, Gill's plan against spin
content: Shubman Gill's aggressive approach against spin was on full display in India's first net session in Colombo, with the captain repeatedly using his feet and clearing the ropes against Ravindra Jadeja, Manav Suthar and Saransh Jain. With Kuldeep Yadav's place under discussion, India's spin combination is another key selection call ahead of the second Test.

title: Delhi government orders construction ban for 42 days to tackle winter air pollution
content: Delhi will ban all construction activities from December 10 to January 20. This measure aims to control the city's severe winter air pollution levels. AI-enabled cameras and a Dust Portal will monitor construction sites for violations. The government will issue warnings and fines for non-compliance with the new rules. Citizens are encouraged to report any observed construction work during this period.

title: 'Pass on the weed': Ex-India cricketer mocks de Villiers over Kohli-Sachin take
content: In a recent discussion, former Indian cricketer Dodda Ganesh shared his thoughts on AB de Villiers' statement comparing Virat Kohli and Sachin Tendulkar. While de Villiers lauded Kohli's performance in overseas Test matches, Tendulkar's statistics suggest a more impressive overall record outside India. Kohli's successes as a captain and during his prime also contribute to the ongoing debate regarding their Test legacies and who truly holds the edge.

title: Madhubala asked Kamal Amrohi to divorce his wife and be with her, recalls Tajdar Amrohi

Choosing loyalty to his family, Kamal rejected her plea, thinking her request was unreasonable. This disagreement ultimately led to the end of their romantic relationship.

title: BJP-ruled Nagpur civic body sings 2 stanzas of Vande Mataram

This oversight has sparked inquiries about the adherence to the Centre's directive for a complete rendition of the song. Legal protections under the National Honour Insult Prevention Act safeguard the song's significance.

title: Defective house, inferior materials: Consumer panel orders builder to pay Rs 25 lakh
content: A builder must pay Rs 25 lakh for constructing a house with serious defects.  The consumer commission found inferior materials and substandard workmanship in the property.  Visakh K. alleged numerous issues after taking possession of his home.  The builder failed to appear before the commission and was proceeded against ex parte.  The commission awarded Rs 20 lakh for repairs and Rs 5 lakh for mental agony.

title: 'No Rs 600 crore property inheritance': Tajdar Amrohi on rift with Preity Zinta

Tajdar Amrohi has raised questions regarding both the timing and legitimacy of Zinta's financial demands. He firmly rejected the notion that his brother promised Zinta a Rs 600 crore inheritance, clarifying that gifts sent to Zinta were merely tokens of admiration from a fan.

title: 'Hypnotised' with water, raped: Mumbai airhostess falls prey to 'evil eye' ploy

Police arrested the 28-year-old accused within four hours of the FIR being registered. His movements were traced using footage from over one hundred CCTV cameras. The accused faces charges including rape and criminal intimidation.

title: North Korea fires 10 missiles amid US scaling back military drills with the South
content: On Thursday, North Korea fired ten short-range ballistic missiles into eastern waters, a provocative move following the United States' decision to reduce joint military exercises with South Korea. The South Korean military enhanced its monitoring efforts and shared intelligence with its allies. Meanwhile, North Korea dismissed diplomatic outreach from the US President as unworthy of a response. Such missile tests violate United Nations Security Council resolutions.

title: Rajya Sabha member's son in soup after Aston Martin crash kills woman in Hyderabad

The victim, Bharati Mukhi, was crossing the road when the speeding car hit her severely. Sanjush, who tested negative for alcohol and drugs, rushed her to the hospital. Police registered a case under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for causing death by negligence.

title: 'Ready To Back Crazy Ideas': Zerodha CEO Says Trading May Change Forever
content: Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath says he would not be surprised if the traditional role of a broker changes dramatically in the future.

title: Thieves Smash Jaipur Trader's Car Window In Delhi, Steal Rs 2 Crore Jewellery
content: According to a complaint filed with the police, Kanhaiya had arrived in Delhi on August 18 with his son Dhruv Soni and a staff member.

title: Revanth Reddy's US Visit Cancelled After Centre Denies Permission
content: Revant Reddy, who is in London currently, has planned to visit the US and return to Hyderabad on August 30.

title: How 2 'Shooters' On Way To Kill Delhi Doctor Landed In A Hospital
content: Himanshu Bhau had allegedly threatened Dr Narendra Sharma, owner of RRM Hospital, and said that shooters could be sent to the area.

title: Revanth Reddy denied permission for US visit by Centre: Telangana CMO
content: the central govt has denied permission to CM Revanth's tour of the united kingdom . he will cut short his visit and return to the city on august 23 . the state government had sought central permission for the trip to the UK and USA .

title: 'Waiting for astrologer to fix date?' Udhayanidhi asks Vijay to act on corruption claims
content: udhayanidhi questioned the delay in making the findings public . he said the government did not have sufficient evidence to support its allegations . the chief minister urged him to open the files immediately and take action if there was evidence of wrongdoing .

title: ‘Baby Shark’ boy returns to stage, this time as a K-pop singer
content: park geonroung is the child star of Pinkfong's "Baby Shark Dance" the 2016 video has more than 17.2 billion views and remains the most-watched video in YouTube history . now 17, Park released his first digital single, "WAVE" under the stage name Baby Shark Boy .

title: Did CM Vijay 'dilute' Tamil Nadu's delimitation stand? TVK, DMK clash in assembly
content: the two parties clashed over the state's official stance on the upcoming delimitation exercise . the exchange came after chief minister omitted the term "freeze" during the meeting . chief minister C Joseph Vijay did not use the word 'freeze' at the meeting, DMK says .

title: 'Over 600 beadbis in 10 yrs': Harsimrat targets AAP, Cong over sacrilege cases
content: 'over 600 beadbis' took place in a decade, says sAD leader . 'we are very sorry for it,' she says . "we have vowed that until we punish the perpetrators, we will not rest," she apologises .

title: 'Over 200 pellets in body, lost eye': Rahul sits on dharna with victim; seeks FIR
content: Priyanka Gandhi joins Rahul Gandhi staging a 'dharna' at the Sansad Marg police station . he sought registration of a complaint over police action and excessive use of force against student protesters during a demonstration .

title: Rahul's dharna, FIR demand, face-off: How drama unfolded over pellet use
content: Rahul Gandhi claimed that police refused to register a complaint over the "police brutality" during the student protest at Jantar Mantar . police allegedly did not provide an I/O number or acknowledgement . the complaint was followed up again on august 17 through email and phone .
